name: com.meetario/booking
title: Meetario Booking
description: Book a meeting with any Meetario host: find free slots and request a booking, no login.

tools.name: get_host
tools.description: Look up a host by exact username or booking link. Returns the host name and the meeting types they offer, with duration, price and the questions the booking form asks.

host.description: Host username or booking link, e.g. "maryna" or "https://meetario.com/booking/maryna/english-lesson"

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Free start times for a meeting type on one date, in the given timezone.

event_type_id.description: Meeting type id from get_host, e.g. "et_3f9a..."

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the user, e.g. "Europe/Kyiv"

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Request a slot returned by get_available_slots. Only call after the user confirmed the slot and their details; pass confirm=true. The meeting is NOT booked by this call: the user gets an email with a confirmation link and the booking is made when they press it. Tell the user to check their inbox.

timezone.description: The same IANA timezone used for get_available_slots

answers.description: Answers to the booking questions from get_host, keyed by question id

confirm.description: Must be true: the user confirmed this booking
